description: Connect a Bluesky account using an app password, never the account password. An app password looks like xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx and is created in Bluesky under Settings, Privacy and Security, App Passwords (https://bsky.app/settings/app-passwords). Anything else is refused with bluesky_app_password_required.

app_password.description: Bluesky app password, shaped xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx (four groups of four lowercase letters or digits). The account password is refused.

identifier.description: Bluesky handle. The first part alone is enough ("user"), and "user.bsky.social", a handle on your own domain, or the account email also work.

name: chirpie_connect_bluesky
title: Connect a Bluesky account
